publication.titleEn: LongCat 2.5 Preview review: thinking modes, SVG and cycling animation
publication.summaryZh: 美团 LongCat 2.5 Preview 实测：对比开启与关闭思考的 SVG、鹈鹕骑车动画、钟表、图表及中文海报，保留失败重试和 33 次文本/代码测试，说明官方基准资料核查范围。
publication.summaryEn: LongCat 2.5 Preview review: thinking-on/off SVGs, cycling animations, clocks, charts and Chinese posters, with retry evidence and 33 original text/code attempts.

descriptionZh: LongCat 文档公开 thinking 开关与 thinking_budget，但没有命名为 low / max 的 effort 档位，因此不伪造这两个档位的成绩。当前对比默认开启与关闭，温度分别固定为 1.0 / 0.7。本轮补跑原先失败的 SVG，并新增两档动画。
descriptionEn: LongCat documents a thinking switch and thinking_budget, but no named low/max effort levels, so no low/max scores are claimed. We compare default-on and off, with documented temperatures fixed at 1.0/0.7. This batch retries failed SVGs and adds animations in both modes.
